svg.text: CONCEPT DESIGN | IMAGE-INFERRED | NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
概念方案｜图像反推｜尺寸、结构、机电待核验
Source: two campus AI images + fab1.jpg; official analogues documented in analysis/cad/.
CAD model in mm; site coordinates X east, Y north, Z up. Internal layouts and member sizes are design estimates.
Plans/sections are extracted from actual FreeCAD BRep. Elevations project component outlines; hidden edges omitted per component.
Civic wing roofs and skylight may differ from the nominal building height; inspect actual geometry and parameter aliases.
No process certification, structural verification, measured survey, or construction approval is implied.
